description: Neutral governance-integration boundary owned by the Agent Runtime. The runtime constructs an immutable TransitionProposal, asks whether that exact proposal may proceed, and obeys the answer. It never authors policy, binds a decision, or creates authority.

method.name: evaluate
method.evaluation_time: caller-controlled (runtime supplies its injected clock value)

proposal_immutability: Arguments are recursively frozen at construction (read-only mappings, tuples, frozensets); scalars only otherwise. Unsupported argument types fail closed with ProposalError. Provider-invocation arguments are re-materialized as a fresh mutable structure only after clearance validation. A governance hook cannot mutate proposal identity.

mapping.CLEAR: CONTINUE — only if the exact-action clearance check passes
mapping.HOLD: WAIT (task/workflow WAITING; no authority created; provider not called)
mapping.ESCALATE: PAUSE (workflow PAUSED pending external authority/review; provider not called)

required_for_clear: proposal_fingerprint == proposal.fingerprint (correlation is part of the fingerprint)
at least one non-empty binding reference (evaluation/authorization/clearance)
valid_until (when set) not reached — inclusive: now < valid_until required
when proposal has a correlation id: correlation_reference present AND equal to it
exact_action_binding.correlation_binding: mandatory when the proposal has a correlation id; missing or mismatched fails closed. When correlation id is absent, no correlation binding is required.
exact_action_binding.post_clearance_recheck: The provider invocation is re-fingerprinted immediately before the call; any drift from the evaluated proposal fails closed (never executes).

default_hook.name: ugence_agent_runtime.governance.hooks.UnconfiguredGovernanceHook
default_hook.behavior: BLOCK with reason GOVERNANCE_NOT_CONFIGURED — fail closed when no adapter is configured

test_only_hook.name: ugence_agent_runtime.governance.hooks.AllowAllGovernanceHook
test_only_hook.behavior: CLEAR bound to the proposal fingerprint. Explicit, opt-in, UNSAFE for consequential production execution; never a default.
